question: How much of the frame table's standalone signal is carried by the two CDS-derived columns, which a WINDOW SHUFFLE leaves byte-identical between treatment and control?
why_this_runs_before_the_control_is_buil: The proposed shuffled-window control relocates windows, which changes only the three mask-derived columns. If the two cds_rows-derived columns carry the signal, the control is a near-copy of the treatment, attributable_absorption collapses toward zero, and the grader fires INDETERMINATE_ABSORPTION_NOT_ATTRIBUTABLE for a reason that is an artifact of shared columns rather than a fact about position.

column_partition.note: frame_features() receives window information ONLY as the union mask. The cds_derived columns are computed from cds_rows and are INVARIANT under any relocation of the window set.

absorption.note: Absorption here is the GAIN a baseline receives from the columns (gc+X minus gc), NOT the margin-shrinkage figure the frozen bar grades. It is reported because a shuffled-window control's absorption is what the grader would compare against.

decisive_ratio.note: Shares do not sum to 1: the two halves overlap, because corpus windows are defined as the 200 bp upstream of annotated gene starts, so signed_distance_to_next_cds_start is a continuous restatement of in_window_any.

paired_within_seed.note: Paired within seed. If cds_minus_frame straddles zero with roughly half the seeds on each side, the two CDS columns ALONE match the full five-column table, so the three window columns carry no unique standalone signal and a window shuffle cannot remove the frame table's predictive content.

honest_limits: This measures the COLUMN partition only. It does not measure a shuffled control; it measures what such a control could not change.
It does NOT re-grade the frame arm and consults no acceptance bar. The frame verdict FRAME_PARTIAL and its resolved=false status are untouched.
The share is a ratio of medians over 10 seeds on 25 percent peak-disjoint held-out splits; the two halves overlap, so the shares are not a variance decomposition.
A viable verdict on this axis would NOT make a window shuffle matched on gene density. Independent per-window relocation still breaks density; a circular shift of the whole annotation preserves it.
